item.title: Melatonin 0.1.6
item.description:
Melatonin 0.1.6

  • Auto mode picks up again after a safety stop. If low battery or heat paused it while an agent was working, it now comes back on by itself once you plug in, lower the battery limit or your Mac cools down. Before, it stayed off until the agent finished.
  • The menu says what it's waiting for: “resumes when you plug in” or “resumes once it cools down”.
